newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Aramco issues new bunker fuel prices.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Aramco issues new bunker fuel prices.

text.p: Saudi Aramco has announced bunker fuel price changes with effect August 7 which includes a new quotation for 380-cst bunker fuel from Ras Tanura and Dammam and a quote for A-954 bunker fuel oil from Jeddah and Yanbu.
A-960 (180-cst) from Ras Tanura and Dammam is $105.50 a tonne ($16.23 a barrel) from $103.00 a tonne ($15.81). A-888 bunker diesel is $3 a tonne higher at $204 a tonne.
Aramco quoted bunker fuel (380-cst) grade from the two Gulf ports at $102 a tonne ($15.69).
A-960 (180-cst) from Jeddah and Yanbu is unchanged at $101 a tonne ($15.50). A-888 bunker diesel is increased to $192 a tonne from $189.
A-954 bunker fuel oil (380-cst) from the two Red Sea ports is priced at $98 a tonne ($15.07).
